<thought>Since the specific functional‑group criteria returned no templates, we will retrieve the most relevant templates for the target molecule (trans‑cinnamic acid) without additional filters. This should provide a template that matches the Doebner modification, from which we can obtain the mapped reaction SMILES and its template_id.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C(O)/C=C/c1ccccc1",
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
